SecretsOfMana is a Terraria mod built with tModLoader (C#; per `build.txt`, by Cade and Nic). Content lives by type under `Items/`, `NPCS/`, `Projectiles/`, `Tiles/`, `Buffs/`, and `Player/`, and each class's namespace mirrors its folder path, which tModLoader also uses to find the class's sprite. The repository is named Comenzo, but the mod is SecretsOfMana: `SecretsOfMana.csproj` imports `..\tModLoader.targets`, so it only builds when checked out as `ModSources/SecretsOfMana`.
